params.message:
Read the Studio SEO overrides again and fit meta descriptions

The redesign's content layer stopped reading the seo object, so the Dutch and
English home titles already in the Studio never reached the page, every page
shared og-default.png, and sameAs lost the three profile links.

- lib/seo.ts: resolveMeta (override in the page language only, else the page
  default) and metaDescription (whole sentences up to 160 characters, else a
  word cut with an ellipsis); tested, and the tests fail when either rule breaks
- cases and blog posts share a 1200x630 crop of their hero or cover
- siteSettings.socialLinks back in the organisation JSON-LD

Only the head changes: the built body of Home, a case, About and a post is
byte-identical to the live pages.
